title: A simple proof for the insulated conductivity problem and application to flat boundaries
summary: In high-contrast composites, the electric (or stress) field may exhibit significant amplification in the narrow region between inclusions. The behavior of the solution depends on the distance $ε$ between the inclusions, which tends to $0$. The purpose of this paper is to provide a simple proof of optimal pointwise estimates for the insulated conductivity problem in any dimension, including the case of flat inclusions.
